title: Constant higher direct images in isomorphic Cartesian presentations
statement: Let a:Y' to Y, h':Y' to X', h:Y to X and b:X' to X form a Cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with b an isomorphism. Let M be an abelian group and q an integer. If the q-th higher direct image along h' of the constant etale sheaf M on Y' is zero, then the q-th higher direct image along h of the constant sheaf M on Y is zero [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].

source.place: Tag 0F1I, lemma-punctual-base-change, degree-zero and bounded-exponent reductions; Tag 073E, filtered colimits

proof.text: Exact inverse image along b is an equivalence. Its homology comparison and the canonical derived exchange identify the inverse image of the original higher direct image with the higher direct image on the Cartesian model. Pullback preserves the constant sheaf: compose the constant-sheaf/global-sections adjunction with inverse/direct image and use uniqueness of left adjoints. Reflect the zero object through the equivalence.

theorem isZero_constantHigherDirectImage_of_isomorphic_square
    {Y Y' X X' : Scheme.{u}} {a : Y' ⟶ Y} {h' : Y' ⟶ X'}
    {h : Y ⟶ X} {b : X' ⟶ X} (sq : IsPullback a h' h b) [IsIso b]
    (M : AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℤ)
    (hz : IsZero ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
      ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h').rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((constantSheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj M))))) :
    IsZero ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
      ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj M))))
